content:
sam: quick sanity check — ran a small GPTQ bake across Llama/Mistral/Qwen yesterday, seeing odd accuracy regressions at long context for some 4-bit configs. posting short summary + repro.

anya: oof, how big are the deltas?

sam: perf highlights:
- Llama-2-13B GPTQ-4: instr-following drop ~6.8% vs fp16 baseline on our eval set, ppl delta +2.3
- Mistral-7B GPTQ-4: instr-following drop ~4.0%, ppl delta +3.1
- Qwen-7B GPTQ-4: instr-following drop ~12.5%, ppl delta +1.0 (weird higher instr drop despite small ppl change)

chen: that instr-following drop on Qwen is concerning. any pattern (long prompts, system prompts, tool-calling)?

sam: mostly long-context threads (>4k tokens) and instruction-heavy templates. short prompts (<512) are fine. KV-cache replay traces show token misalignment for Qwen in some sessions.

bench-bot: automated-run: 2419876500 gptq-run summary:
```
models: [llama-2-13b, mistral-7b, qwen-7b]
quant: gptq 4-bit, group-size=64
evals: inst-follow, ppl, codegen-smoke
results:
  llama-2-13b: inst_delta=-6.8%, ppl_delta=+2.3
  mistral-7b: inst_delta=-4.0%, ppl_delta=+3.1
  qwen-7b: inst_delta=-12.5%, ppl_delta=+1.0
```

maria: did you compare against an INT8 AWQ or FP8 run?

sam: yes — AWQ int8 (single-run):
- AWQ-int8 Mistral: inst_delta -1.1%, ppl +0.8
- AWQ-int8 Qwen: inst_delta -6.0%, ppl +0.9
- AWQ-int8 Llama: inst_delta -2.3%, ppl +1.1

liam: so GPTQ4 is worse for Qwen on instr-following despite similar ppl. suggests behavior shift rather than raw language model capacity. maybe quantization of attention parameters or KV layout mismatch.

nate: any log snippets for the KV misalignment?

sam: pasted a short trace where context tokens shift by one after a flush — reproduced locally.

```
# simplified trace
request_ctx: [A B C D E ...]
kv_after_step_10: keys len=1024
tokens_out_step_11: expected=F got=G
# mismatch starts at token index 2048 for qwen-gptq
```

chen: can you share the exact quant flags used? group-size, per-channel, layerwise?

sam: run config: `--quant gptq --bits 4 --group-size 64 --per-channel True --use-fused-kv False`

maria: curious: changing group-size helped in previous runs?

sam: small experiments: group-size=256 reduces instr-drop on Qwen from -12.5% -> -7.2%, but latency increases ~6% for decoding. group-size=1024 further reduces drop to -4.1% but latency hit ~15% and memory usage up.

eva: tradeoff: accuracy vs latency/cost. for production, maybe use AWQ-int8 for Qwen, keep GPTQ-4 for Llama & Mistral where it behaves.

liam: agree. also need to test KV cache correctness under streaming and long-batched requests. Could be an alignment bug in our KV packing when using smaller group sizes.

sam: next steps I propose: 
1) run deterministic KV replay on Qwen with varying group-size (64/128/256/1024) and check token-by-token divergence scripts (assigned: @chen)
2) run AWQ-int8 vs GPTQ-4 smoke in our dedicated infra (assigned: @maria)
3) add regression tests for long-context instruction prompts to our nightly (assigned: @liam)
4) hold Qwen-gptq4 from canary until we have green KV replay (assigned: @nate)

chen: started a small repro branch: `kg/qwen-gptq-kv-repro`, will push traces and a small script to diff logits/token output.

maria: I'll schedule AWQ runs on dedicated tomorrow morning and post full CSVs.

nate: marking Qwen-gptq4 canary disabled in rollout policy (just in case), added a note in console.

bench-bot: note: canary flag toggled by nate at 2419876605 : :white_check_mark:

eva: for docs: if we keep GPTQ for Llama and Mistral, we should annotate in model-catalog: "GPTQ-4: recommended for Llama-2-13B and Mistral-7B; caution for Qwen-7B at >4k tokens — prefer AWQ-int8 for long-context production." I'll draft a blurb.

sam: thanks — low-touch summary to paste into the bakeoff doc:
```
summary: gptq-4 shows good perf/cost for Llama and Mistral. Qwen-7b exhibits instruction-following regressions at long context likely due to KV alignment under small group-size quantization. Mitigation: increase group-size or use AWQ-int8 for Qwen. Disable Qwen-gptq4 canary until KV replay passes.
```

nanya: cheers. please ping when repro branch pushed.

chen: pushed PR with repro script and initial traces — link: https://git.local/r/redwood/kg/qwen-gptq-kv-repro (internal)

sam: awesome. I'll follow up tomorrow with consolidated CSV and recommended model-catalog wording. :thumbsup:

liam: tiny ask — include a minimal script to convert our existing cached KV dumps into the format your diff script expects. saves time for oncall.

chen: adding that now.

maria: added AWQ run results at 2419876618, uploading CSV to the bakeoff folder.

sam: closing TL;DR: do not ship Qwen-gptq4 to prod for long-context workloads; keep GPTQ for Llama/Mistral with monitoring and a regression eval set.

nate: ack, will update rollout.

bench-bot: thread archived after 2419876620 by bench-bot.
